items.name: MvPowerSeries.weightedOrder_zero
items.type: {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [Semiring R] (w : σ → ℕ) : MvPowerSeries.weightedOrder w 0 = ⊤

items.name: MvPowerSeries.weightedOrder_one
items.type: {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [Semiring R] (w : σ → ℕ) [Nontrivial R] : MvPowerSeries.weightedOrder w 1 = 0

items.name: MvPowerSeries.weightedOrder_eq_top_iff
items.type: {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [Semiring R] (w : σ → ℕ) {f : MvPowerSeries σ R} : MvPowerSeries.weightedOrder w f = ⊤ ↔ f = 0

items.name: MvPowerSeries.ne_zero_iff_weightedOrder_finite
items.type: {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [Semiring R] (w : σ → ℕ) {f : MvPowerSeries σ R} : f ≠ 0 ↔ ↑(MvPowerSeries.weightedOrder w f).toNat = MvPowerSeries.weightedOrder w f

items.name: MvPowerSeries.weightedOrder_neg
items.type: {σ : Type u_1} (w : σ → ℕ) {R : Type u_3} [Ring R] (f : MvPowerSeries σ R) : MvPowerSeries.weightedOrder w (-f) = MvPowerSeries.weightedOrder w f

items.name: MvPowerSeries.le_weightedOrder_mul
items.type: {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [Semiring R] (w : σ → ℕ) {f g : MvPowerSeries σ R} : MvPowerSeries.weightedOrder w f + MvPowerSeries.weightedOrder w g ≤ MvPowerSeries.weightedOrder w (f * g)

items.name: MvPowerSeries.le_weightedOrder_prod
items.type: {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_3} [CommSemiring R] {ι : Type u_4} (w : σ → ℕ) (f : ι → MvPowerSeries σ R) (s : Finset ι) : ∑ i ∈ s, MvPowerSeries.weightedOrder w (f i) ≤ MvPowerSeries.weightedOrder w (∏ i ∈ s, f i)
